name: Pack Light
summary: A packing checklist whose ticked items jump into an open suitcase that zips shut when all are in
about: A checkbox group for a trip to Skardu with a tri-state Pack everything box. Each tick squashes the box, draws a check and strikes the item out, while its icon jumps along an arc into its own spot in an open suitcase, lands with a bounce and wobbles the case. A progress bar and luggage tag count along, and when all six are in, the lid shuts with a dusty thump, the zip runs round and a READY stamp lands on the tag.
how: Click or tap an item, or Tab to it and press Space: the box squashes and the check draws in.
The item's icon jumps along an arc into the suitcase, lands with a squash and the case wobbles.
The bar, counter and luggage tag count up; Pack everything shows a dash while the list is part done.
With all six in, the lid shuts, dust puffs out, the zip runs round and a READY stamp thumps onto the tag.
Untick an item, or untick Pack everything, and the case pops open while things fly back to the list.
